proof-statement-integrity.notes: Per §3b-cond non-degeneracy: the class fields must axiomatize HYPOTHESES and the theorem must DERIVE the conclusion. Here the substantive field aj_saddle_compatibility is ': True' and the theorem's conclusion is a regime-label string equality, NOT the saddle identification the .md asserts. The provable-kind statement is a weakened/relabelled version of the claimed result.

proof-no-self-assuming-projection.notes: The theorem reads back the class's own default field value (rfl), which is structurally a projection of provided data rather than a derivation. Not the canonical conclusion=field anti-pattern (the conclusion is a string, not the AJ identity), but adjacent — the proof asserts what the class trivially supplies.

proof-no-trivial-true.notes: The field carrying the actual mathematical content of the identification is literally ': True := trivial' in BOTH PhiQRegulator and Li2QRegulator. The §3b-tax 'true-class-field' anti-pattern: the conjecture's content is encoded as True, so any instance discharges it vacuously and the conditional theorems prove nothing about the AJ saddles.

proof-no-false-premise.notes: No False premise; classes are inhabitable (degree fields + nonzero disjunction).

proof-no-unused-hypotheses.notes: phi_q_eq_aj_saddle_root_of_unity never uses the [QuantumAPolynomial K] instance (the proof is rfl on PhiQRegulator's field). The AJ-existence hypothesis — supposedly the conditional backbone — is inert in the conditional theorem.
